paper.abstract_en: This review covers the current status of a specific class of solution-generating transformations in D = 11 and D = 10 supergravity theories, called poly-vector deformations. These are generated by a poly-vector constructed from Killing vectors of the initial background, and for the particular case of bi-vectors, are known as Yang-Baxter deformations. Here various properties of such transformations will be discussed: preservation of integrability, generation of brane bound states, as well as geometric interpretation as coordinate transformations in a special extended space-time.
